raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) has rescinded the Biden-era firearms rule, restoring prior export control treatment for civilian firearms and ammunition. This reduces licensing burdens for certain semi-automatic firearms and related parts under the EAR, but does not eliminate all controls: items may still fall under the USML (ITAR) or catch-all/end-user restrictions. Exporters must re-verify ECCN classification, license exceptions, and country-specific prohibitions before shipment. Section 301 tariffs and HTS alignment remain relevant for customs valuation, and Entity List/restricted party screening is still mandatory. The change signals a more permissive posture for civilian firearms exports, but compliance documentation and end-use/end-user checks remain critical.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支规则，恢复了对民用枪支和弹药的原有出口管制待遇。此举减轻了部分半自动枪支及相关部件在《出口管理条例》（EAR）下的许可负担，但并未取消所有管制：相关物项仍可能属于美国军品清单（USML/ITAR）或适用兜底/最终用户限制。出口商在发货前必须重新核实ECCN分类、许可例外及国别禁令。301关税和HTS归类对海关估价仍然重要，实体清单/受限方筛查仍为强制要求。该变化表明对民用枪支出口采取更宽松的立场，但合规单证和最终用途/最终用户核查依然关键。

checklist.desc: Re-verify whether the firearm, part, or ammunition is controlled under the EAR (ECCN) or the ITAR USML; document the classification basis and any license exception eligibility after the rule rescission.

checklist.task: BIS Entity List & restricted party screening
checklist.desc: Run denied party, Entity List, and end-user screening for all US-origin firearms exports; retain end-use/end-user statements and screen for diversion risk.
Map the 10-digit HTS line against Section 301 lists and additional duties; document country of origin, value build-up, and any exclusion eligibility for customs valuation.
Prepare DSP-5/DSP-73 or BIS license application as applicable; include purchase order, end-user certificate, and non-transfer assurances for controlled firearms.
Confirm FCC Part 15/18 compliance for any electronic sights, rangefinders, or wireless accessories; retain supplier FCC IDs and test reports before US entry.
Maintain AES filing, commercial invoice, packing list, and license records for 5 years; ensure consistency between EEI, invoice, and license conditions.
